name: Margot Hellwig
description:
'''Margot Hellwig''' (born Margot Fischer, 5 July 1941 in [[Reit im Winkl]]; married as Margot Lindermayr) is a German [[Alpine folk music]] (''Volksmusik'') singer.

She is best known as part of '''Maria & Margot Hellwig''', a German mother-and-daughter ''Volksmusik'' duo which was active from 1963 until her mother, [[Maria Hellwig]], died in 2010. The surname Hellwig was a stage name for both singers.
